Help/Getting started/Install and sign in

Install the app and sign in

Choose Sign in with Apple or use email. Use the same sign-in on the app and website so your spaces and walkthroughs stay together.

  1. Install Veylet Capture on your supported Pro iPhone or iPad using the invitation link Veylet sent you. The app is in invite-only testing through TestFlight.
  2. Open it and read how it works. Choose Sign in with Apple, or Use email instead and enter the email you use on the website. Your first sign-in creates your account.
  3. For email sign-in, open the link on the same device or enter the six-digit code from the email in the app.
  4. After signing in, start with the practice room from Captures before your first real capture.

If it doesn’t work

No email after a minute? Check your junk folder, then send it again from the app.

If the email link opens somewhere other than the app, return to the app and enter the six-digit code from that email.

Signed up with Apple using Hide My Email? Choose Sign in with Apple again to reach the same account.

Sign-in links and codes work once. If yours has expired or was already used, send a new email.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to support@veylet.com. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
